title: Customer Support Associate
description:
Customer Support Associate - SeatGeek Job Description

Location: Remote - Philippines
Expected Start date: October 19, 2026
Working hours: 8AM - 5PM EST
Working days: 5 working days in a week with 2 days off in a row
Compensation: $700 per month

About SeatGeek

SeatGeek believes live events are powerful experiences that unite humans. With our technological savvy and fan-first attitude, we’re simplifying and modernizing the ticketing industry.

As a Customer Support Representative supporting SeatGeek through Frontier, you’ll help fans navigate every stage of their live-event experience. From accessing tickets before a major game to resolving an unexpected issue close to event time, you’ll provide clear, empathetic, and dependable support when customers need it most.

You’ll assist customers through phone, email, and live chat while developing a strong understanding of SeatGeek’s platform, policies, and customer experience standards. This is a great opportunity for someone who enjoys solving problems, communicating with people, and creating positive experiences in a fast-moving environment.

What you’ll do

• Support SeatGeek customers through phone, email, and live chat

• Help customers with questions related to ticket purchases, ticket delivery, transfers, account access, payments, refunds, and event changes

• Investigate customer concerns using SeatGeek’s systems, policies, and internal resources

• Communicate clearly and empathetically, particularly when customers are dealing with urgent or frustrating situations

• Take ownership of customer issues and work toward accurate, timely, and practical resolutions

• Document customer interactions and resolutions accurately

• Identify situations that require additional support and escalate them through the appropriate channels

• Meet expectations related to customer satisfaction, quality, productivity, attendance, and schedule adherence

• Participate in regular coaching, quality reviews, training, and team meetings

• Follow all customer-data, account-security, confidentiality, and information-security requirements

• Share recurring customer concerns and process gaps with the Team Lead to help improve the overall fan experience

• Collaborate closely with teammates and internal partners to create a consistent and reliable customer experience

What you have

• At least two years of experience in customer support, customer service, contact-center operations, or another customer-facing role

• Strong spoken and written English

• Experience assisting customers through phone, email, or live chat; experience working across multiple channels is preferred

• A customer-first mindset and the ability to remain calm and helpful during difficult conversations

• Strong problem-solving skills and the judgment to determine when an issue should be resolved independently or escalated

• High attention to detail and the ability to document information accurately

• Comfort learning new systems, policies, and workflows

• Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment

• A track record of reliability, punctuality, and ownership

• Openness to feedback and the ability to apply coaching quickly

• A collaborative, “one team” approach to working with colleagues

Remote-work requirements

• A reliable computer that meets the required technical specifications

• A stable high-speed internet connection suitable for voice and video calls

• A dependable backup internet connection

• A quiet and professional workspace

• A reliable headset with a microphone

• Ability to meet SeatGeek and Frontier’s information-security and workspace requirements

Training

You’ll complete a full-time, two-week training program beginning October 19, 2026. The program will introduce you to SeatGeek’s platform, customer experience standards, support systems, policies, and phone, email, and chat workflows.

title: Director of Engineering, Infrastructure
description:
We're building the cloud infrastructure and delivery platform that one of healthcare's most ambitious technology transformations runs on, and we need a Principal Engineer, Cloud Infrastructure to own the infrastructure behind it all. You'll both set the technical direction and do the work hands-on, while leading a small team of infrastructure engineers.
This role is about infrastructure and developer enablement. As our AI strategy evolves, we see a world where many outside of traditional engineering and data roles will contribute to our technology ecosystem. We believe reliability, security, and cost discipline come from good platform design and automation, and that ticket queues and runbooks are signs we haven't solved the underlying problem. You'll bring a clear point of view on what a modern, AI-native infrastructure org should look like, the judgment and technical skill to make it real, and the leadership instincts to build and develop the contributors around you.
In this role you will:

• Own cloud infrastructure end-to-end across our cloud environments, staying hands-on with IaC, CI/CD, and observability alongside the team

• Own the SDLC surface area (dev environments, lower envs, release mechanics, monitoring and response) so engineers can ship in minutes rather than days

• Build the substrate that lets AI agents observe, reason, and act on business systems with safe defaults, and the rails that let AI-assisted apps from people outside of tech be deployed and supported without becoming operational liabilities

• Participate in security operations alongside our SecOps team on CSPM, threat management, and patch management as the infrastructure-side owner of remediations

• Frame infrastructure decisions in terms of business outcomes (operational efficiency, financial impact, clinical results), and make progress and tradeoffs visible to leadership as a natural byproduct of how you work

• Lead and develop a small, high-impact team, and operate as a peer to our SecOps, Data, IT Systems, and App Engineering leaders as a unifying technical force across the org

You should get in touch if:

• You have an engineering background with deep, hands-on experience operating production infrastructure across at least two major clouds (GCP, AWS, Azure) and with modern infrastructure-as-code (Terraform or similar)

• You have built and operated modern CI/CD systems, dev environments, and observability stacks. What you've shipped matters more than the size of the fleet you've managed.

• You've built and operated infrastructure across different company sizes and business contexts. Cross-domain breadth is a real asset; experience in regulated domains (healthcare, financial services) is helpful but not required

• You hold a strong, well-reasoned point of view on platform philosophy, and can defend when to standardize, when to give teams room, and how to make the safe path the easy path

• You have shipped AI-native operational systems. That might be AI agents that triage alerts, draft RCAs, manage cost, or execute runbooks, or frameworks that let non-traditional contributors (junior engineers, analysts, AI agents, vibe-coders) ship safely.

• You're action-oriented on governance and security participation. You document what matters, automate what you can, and don't let process become a bottleneck

• You have built and developed teams. You think about composition intentionally, hire for gaps, and invest in people's growth

• You're a strong communicator: clear, direct, and concise with both technical and non-technical audiences

• First 90 Days: Develop a clear point of view on the current state of the infrastructure, CI/CD, and operational tooling. Identify the highest-leverage opportunities. Ship a first step-function improvement or eliminate a fundamental operational limitation.

title: Business Development Representative
description:
About Wellspring

Wellspring Worldwide, Inc. is a leading provider of web-based software systems for managing research, technology commercialization, and innovation operations for universities, companies, government agencies, and independent labs. Founded in 2003, Wellspring has grown to serve over 500 organizations globally, including Fortune 500 companies, SMEs, hospitals, and universities. The company’s flagship products-Evolve, Astria, Sophia & Flintbox-enable organizations to manage the entire innovation lifecycle, from discovery and IP management to commercialization and knowledge transfer.

The Business Development Representative (BDR) is the engine of top-of-funnel growth. You will own the full prospecting motion - from identifying and sourcing target contacts to feeding them into multi-channel outbound campaigns, nurturing prospects through early-stage conversations, and converting engagement into qualified pipeline. You will also serve as the first human touch for inbound inquiries, respond quickly to capture intent, and work hand-in-hand with Account Executives to book, run, and advance discovery calls. Your output is measured in Sales Qualified Leads (SQLs) and pipeline dollars delivered.

Core Responsibilities

Prospecting & Contact Intelligence

• Research and build target account lists aligned to the Ideal Customer Profile (ICP) using tools such as LinkedIn Sales Navigator, ZoomInfo,Prospeo,Apollo, Cognism, or Clay.

• Identify, source, and validate key decision-maker contacts (title, email, phone, LinkedIn profile) before loading them into outbound sequences.

• Use intent data, technographic signals, and firmographic filters to prioritize high-fit, high-intent accounts.

• Maintain rigorous contact hygiene - verify data accuracy before every campaign load to protect sender reputation and improve deliverability.

• Monitor trigger events (funding rounds, executive hires, product launches, job postings) to identify timely outreach opportunities.

Outbound Campaigns & Multi-Channel Outreach

• Build, launch, and optimize outbound sequences using sales engagement platforms (e.g., Outreach, Salesloft, HubSpot Sequences) across email, phone,andLinkedIn.

• Personalize messaging at scale - tailor subject lines, opening lines, and value propositions to persona, vertical, and pain point.

• Execute a structured daily outreach cadence: cold calls, cold emails, LinkedIn connection requests and messages.

• A/B test subject lines, call-to-action language, and sequence steps; use performance data to iterate and improve reply and booking rates.

• Leverage AI writing assistants and research tools to accelerate personalization without sacrificing quality.

title: Standards Development Organization Liaison / Knowledge Management
description:
Job Summary
This role is VA’s point of contact with the outside organizations that write and ballot health data standards. That means sitting in HL7, SNOMED, LOINC and similar workgroups, carrying VA’s position into those discussions, and bringing back what changed and what it actually means for VHA systems and workflows. The other half of the job is knowledge management. Standards work generates a lot of material, implementation guides, mappings, decision records, meeting notes, and most programs lose track of it. This person keeps that content organized, current, and easy for the team to find so the program is not rebuilding the same answer every few months.
Primary Responsibilities
Standards Development Organization Engagement

• Represents VHA in standards development organizations and related bodies, including HL7, SNOMED International, Regenstrief/LOINC, NCPDP, X12, DICOM, IHE, and ISO/TC 215, along with federal standards forums and cross-agency workgroups.

• Tracks ballot cycles, comment periods, workgroup calendars, and implementation guide development across multiple organizations at once.

• Prepares and submits VA comments, ballot reconciliations, and change requests.

• Coordinates VA participation so the right clinical and technical people show up to the right meetings with a consistent position, and follows through on commitments VA makes in those forums.

• Maintains working relationships with SDO staff, cochairs, and counterparts at other federal agencies.

• Gives the program early warning when a standard is moving in a direction that will create downstream work.

Standards Analysis and Program Advisory

• Analyzes draft and published standards, implementation guides, and terminology releases for operational impact on VHA systems and workflows.

• Translates what a standard actually requires into plain terms for informatics analysts, clinical SMEs, architects, and program leadership.

• Advises on adoption timing, conformance expectations, gaps between a published standard and how VHA currently does the work, and the practical cost of closing that gap.

• Supports requirements development and interoperability design decisions where standards conformance is in play.

• Flags conflicts between competing standards, or between a standard and existing VA policy, and works the issue toward a decision rather than handing it off.

Knowledge Management

• Owns the program’s knowledge management approach for standards and interoperability content.

• Builds and maintains the repository structure, taxonomy, naming conventions, and version control that keep artifacts findable and current.

• Curates implementation guides, value sets, terminology mappings, decision records, position papers, meeting summaries, and lessons learned.

• Establishes review cycles so content gets retired or refreshed instead of quietly going stale.

• Develops SOPs, job aids, reference materials, and onboarding content that let new team members get productive without a long ramp.

• Supports communities of practice and recurring knowledge sharing sessions across the program.

Coordination and Delivery

• Manages the schedule, dependencies, and deliverables tied to standards participation and knowledge management work.

• Produces status reporting, briefing materials, and executive summaries for VA leadership.

• Facilitates working sessions and workgroup meetings, captures decisions and action items, and drives them to closure.

• Coordinates with other OIP work streams and with adjacent VA programs so standards positions and reference content stay aligned across the enterprise.

• Supports government leads with documentation, meeting logistics, and follow-through on external commitments.

Minimum Qualifications

• Bachelor’s degree.

• Ten years of experience. The ten years must be in project management for standards development.

• Demonstrated participation in one or more health data standards development organizations, including ballot, com

title: Manager I, Engineering - Source Code Integration

description:
Senior Site Reliability Engineer (SRE)
We are seeking a highly skilled and passionate Senior Site Reliability Engineer to join our Engineering Enablement team. This is a critical role within a large, complex, and high-impact initiative focused on deconstructing our monolithic architecture, revitalising our technology stack, and embedding quality and resilience into every stage of our development lifecycle.
You will play a pivotal role in shaping our future-state platform, driving operational excellence, and fostering a culture of continuous improvement.
What You'll Do:
As a Senior SRE Engineer in our Engineering Enablement team, you will:

• Architect and Implement Reliability: Design, build, and maintain highly scalable, resilient, and performant systems on Azure, focusing on our Java, Kafka, and Couchbase stack.

• Drive Modernisation: Work hands-on as part of the team spearheading the adoption of Micronaut, standardising application templates, and transitioning to managed cloud services.

• Enhance Operational Excellence: Develop and implement strategies for improving system observability (standardised logging, metrics, tracing), alerting, and on-call practices.

• Automate Everything: Champion automation across the software development lifecycle (SDLC), from CI/CD pipelines to infrastructure provisioning, focusing on accelerating delivery and de-risking deployments.

• Incident Management & Learning: Contribute to our mature, blameless post- incident review process, identifying root causes and implementing preventative measures to reduce incident hours.

• Tooling & Standards: Develop, maintain, and drive the adoption of shared, standardised SRE tooling and best practices across engineering teams, including containerisation (e.g., Docker, Kubernetes on Azure), infrastructure as code (e.g.,Terraform), and configuration management.

• Mentorship & Collaboration: Provide technical leadership and mentorship to junior engineers, fostering a culture of SRE principles and operational excellence across the wider engineering organisation.

• Strategic Input: Contribute to the overall technical strategy and roadmap for our SRE and platform initiatives, ensuring alignment with business objectives.

What You'll Bring:

• Deep SRE Expertise: Proven experience as a Senior Site Reliability Engineer or a similar role, with a strong understanding of SRE principles (error budgets, SLOs/SLIs, toil reduction).

• Azure Cloud Proficiency: Extensive hands-on experience designing, deploying, and operating highly available and scalable applications on Microsoft Azure.

• Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS) Expertise: Mandatory extensive hands-on experience with AKS for container orchestration, including deployment, scaling, monitoring, and troubleshooting.

• Java Ecosystem Mastery: Expert-level proficiency with Java, including experience with modern frameworks (ideally Micronaut, Spring Boot, or similar) and JVM performance tuning.

• Distributed Systems Knowledge: Solid understanding and practical experience with distributed systems, microservices architecture, and associated challenges (e.g., consistency, fault tolerance).

• Messaging & Database Expertise: Hands-on experience with an event streaming platform (ideally Kafka) and NoSQL data storage (ideally Couchbase), including operational best practices.

• Automation First Mindset: Strong scripting skills (e.g., Python, Bash) and experience with Infrastructure as Code tools (e.g., Terraform, ARM templates) and CI/CD pipelines (e.g., Azure DevOps, Jenkins).

• Observability Tools: Experience with monitoring, logging, and alerting tools (e.g., Azure Monitor, Prometheus, Grafana, ELK Stack, Splunk).

• Problem-Solving Acumen: Exceptional analytical and troubleshooting skills, with a methodical approach to diagnosing and resolving complex production issues.

• Communication & Collaboration: Excellent communication skills, with the ability to articulate complex technical concepts to diverse audiences

Overview
Experience the advantages of real career change!
When you join Piedmont, you’re not just changing your work environment. We open doors to real change in the lives we touch - especially yours. Responsibilities
This position specializes in using ionizing radiation to produce cross-sectional images to help doctors diagnose and treat patients. CT Technologists perform diagnostic Computerized Tomographic examinations in accordance with all prescribed standards under the direct guidance of the supervising radiologist. CT Technologists provide patient care to all age groups to include neonatal, pediatrics, adult, and geriatrics. The Virtual CT technologist must demonstrate the ability to perform advanced CT imaging while incorporating competent/proficient knowledge of cross-sectional anatomy and physiology. Virtual CT technologists must be capable of providing and directing safe competent technical care based on each patient's identified needs, regardless of complexity, utilizing remote communication tools and relying on the cooperative clinical skills of the on-site CT support team.
What you will do

• The remote technologist demonstrates competence and proficiency in performing all CT procedures on patients of all age groups. The remote technologist assists with correct patient positioning, protocol selection and utilizes all required equipment.

• The remote technologist maintains competencies in all non-scanner related components.

• The remote technologist accurately follows established imaging protocols for exams being performed.

• Adheres to the Radiation Safety Policies and the principles of a viable dose reduction program.

• Performs quality control procedures in accordance with the ACR guidelines.

• The remote technologist must possess the ability to post-process advance imaging procedures by using applications such as Syngo-Via.

• The remote technologist must function independently with little guidance from a manager.

• The remote technologist must review all orders and protocols for appropriateness, all labs and all legal documentation to confirm patient readiness prior to scan.

• All Safety behavior and tools must be practiced and adhered to throughout the patient encounter.

• Remotely initiates and controls scanning and technical parameters in real time while monitoring image quality.

• Maintains continuous audio/video communications with on-site support team and provides guidance to the qualified on-site operator.

• Documents scan details, protocol deviations, and technical issues.

• Use remote sessions as opportunities to train on-site staff toward full technical competency.

Qualifications
Education

• Graduate of an accredited college for Radiologic Technology required
Work Experience

• 2 years of experience as a CT Technologist required
Licenses and Certifications

• Registered by the American Registry of Radiologic Technology (R) (CT) required

• Advanced certification by ARRT in Computed Tomography (CT) required

• BLS certified required

families.
 
We are fiercely dedicated to accelerating the rapid transition taking place in the energy industry to a more decentralized and cleaner approach to power generation. We are committed to positively contributing to the local communities and people we serve with more than clean energy. We believe global warming poses an existential threat to our planet and that we have a responsibility to help mitigate the threat. At Pivot, we are proactively developing and maintaining an inclusive culture, rooted in mutual respect, that supports a workforce of different generations, races, gender identities, sexual orientations, ability statuses, religions, and cultures to work collaboratively together for greater impact. We seek to build a team that invests in relationship building, celebrates each other’s successes, and makes space for the unique contributions and working styles people bring into Pivot.

title: Principal Product Manager, AI Platform
description:
About the Role
This is a high-impact role at the center of a strategic shift toward an AI-first operating model, sitting within a small, focused team rebuilding core business operations around AI. You will move the organization away from manual processes and third-party tools toward an owned, intelligent platform, serving a broad client base across diverse industries.
What You'll Do

• Identify critical operational problems, design solutions, and prototype them using AI tools against real-world data.

• Collaborate closely with engineers to productionize prototypes into reliable, scalable systems.

• Define measurable metrics for complex operational issues and develop AI-driven solutions to address them.

• Own the development of a sophisticated decision engine, replacing vendor reporting with a tailored internal platform serving varied user needs.

• Drive product judgment for closed-loop attribution systems that connect client actions to revenue outcomes.

• Navigate the complexity of building a single platform that serves multiple distinct business units and industries.

• Report directly to senior product and technology leadership, with a clear escalation path for high-stakes decisions.

What We're Looking For

• Proven track record of identifying complex operational problems and designing AI-driven solutions, rather than managing pre-defined roadmaps.

• Hands-on experience building and shipping working software prototypes or tools using AI coding tools.

• Deep understanding of AI capabilities and limitations, including how to design robust systems that account for real-world failure modes and edge cases.

• Strong systems thinking, with an ability to reason about second-order effects, blast radius, and long-term architectural implications.

• Experience designing platform solutions that serve diverse user needs across multiple industries or client types, balancing shared components with configurable elements.

• Demonstrated ability to define complex operational problems in measurable terms and validate solutions with data.

• Experience designing or building decision engines, reporting tools, or closed-loop attribution systems is a strong plus.

• Excellent written communication skills, able to make complex decisions clear and concise in short-form documents.

• Comfort operating autonomously in ambiguous problem spaces within a small, self-directed team.

• Background in marketing services or multi-industry platform products is a plus.

Compensation & Benefits
Salary range: $160,000 to $230,000 USD annually. Visa sponsorship is not available for this role.
Location
Fully remote, based in the United States.

title: New Business Account Executive - Unleashed Software
description:
We’re looking for people to join the Access family, who share our passion for believing in better, and who will help us continue to grow.
Love Work. Love Life. Be You. - is central to our success and how we give our customers the freedom to do more of what's important to them.
What does Access offer you?
We offer a blended approach to office working, encouraging you to collaborate and connect in one of our thriving offices. We deliver on what we say, taking the development of our people seriously. We’ll work with you to progress your success plan and provide opportunities to accelerate your career.
On top of a competitive salary, our wellbeing days taking you to 25 days leave a year and a health contribution, you’ll also be able to choose from a range of benefits to suit you. We’re an organisation that likes to give back, so you’ll also have three charity days allocated to support a cause that matters to you.

About you:

You enjoy owning the full sales journey and seeing the impact of your work from first conversation through to close. You’re naturally curious about how product‑based businesses run and like digging into real operational challenges before suggesting a solution. You’re comfortable working remotely, managing your own day, and you take pride in running a tidy pipeline. At Access, you’ll have the support, coaching and inbound demand to do your best work, while still having the freedom to build your own momentum.

Day to day, you will:

• Manage a mix of inbound and self‑sourced opportunities, taking each one through a clear and structured sales process.

• Run thoughtful discovery calls and product demos that link Unleashed’s inventory management software to real business problems.

• Build relationships with founders, finance leads and operations teams, making sure you understand how decisions are made.

• Own your deals through to close, keeping Salesforce up to date and handing over smoothly to onboarding and customer success.

Your skills and experiences might also include:

• Experience in full‑cycle B2B sales, including prospecting, discovery, demos and commercial conversations.

• Experience selling software to small or medium‑sized businesses, particularly in manufacturing, wholesale or distribution.

• Familiarity with structured sales approaches, such as MEDDPICC or SPIN, to qualify and progress opportunities.

• Confidence talking about technology ecosystems, including accounting software, e‑commerce platforms or integrations.

What are we all about?
The Access Group is one of the largest UK-headquartered business management software providers. It provides solutions that empower more than 160,000 small and mid-sized organisations in commercial and non-profit sectors across Europe, USA and APAC, giving every employee the freedom to do more of what's important. Its innovative cloud solutions and integrated AI software experience across multiple Access products transform how business technology is used.
With over 9,300 talented individuals driving innovation and customer excellence, we’re shaping the future of work. And we want you to be part of it. At Access, people are at the heart of everything we do . We’re committed to creating an inclusive, high-performing culture where everyone feels valued, respected, and empowered to thrive. If you’re excited about this role - even if your experience doesn’t tick every box - you might be exactly who we’re looking for.
We believe in equality for all and the transformative power of diversity. So why not join our vibrant team, where you can love what you do, love how you live, and most importantly, be authentically you?
Let’s make a difference together.
Love Work. Love Life. Be You.

description:
We are seeking a detail-oriented and proactive Dialer to join our team. The Dialer will be responsible for making outbound calls to potential and existing customers using an automated dialing system. The ideal candidate should possess excellent communication skills, maintain professionalism, and be able to handle high call volumes efficiently.
Key Responsibilities

•
Cold Calling & Lead Generation: Proactively reach out to potential clients, identifying and qualifying leads while maintaining a warm and professional approach.

•
Appointment Setting & Follow-ups: Schedule meetings for team members and follow up with prospects to nurture relationships and guide them through the sales process.

•
Sales & Client Engagement: Sell staffing direct-hire and staff augmentation services, clearly communicating value and fostering long-term client relationships.

•
CRM & Database Management: Maintain accurate records of interactions in the CRM system to ensure streamlined communication and organized follow-ups.

•
Customer Support & Product Assistance: Address customer inquiries via phone, email, and chat, providing support for products and services while resolving concerns effectively.

•
Market Research & Industry Awareness: Stay informed on industry trends and insights to provide relevant information to potential clients.

•
Compliance & Call Guidelines: Follow scripts and company policies while adhering to industry regulations regarding outbound calls.

•
Performance & Target Achievement: Meet or exceed call, sales, and revenue targets while maintaining a focus on customer satisfaction.

•
Networking & Relationship Building: Expand professional connections through networking events, associations, and social media platforms.

•
Training & Continuous Improvement: Participate in training sessions to enhance product knowledge, customer service, and sales techniques.

Skills, Knowledge and Expertise

•
Excellent English Proficiency: Strong spoken and written English skills, with the ability to articulate ideas clearly and persuasively over the phone.

•
Sales & Customer Service Experience: 2-3 years of experience in cold calling, telemarketing, or call center roles targeting US companies. Previous sales or customer service experience is advantageous.

•
Competitive & Goal-Oriented: Tenacious sales attitude, persistence in making high-volume outbound calls, and the ability to handle rejection professionally.

•
Service-Oriented & Relationship Building: Strong customer service skills with the ability to build rapport, establish relationships, and provide a positive experience for potential clients.

•
Communication & Listening Skills: Strong verbal communication and active listening skills to effectively engage prospects and address their needs.

•
Organizational & Multitasking Abilities: Ability to manage multiple leads, prioritize tasks efficiently, and work in a fast-paced environment.

•
Tech-savvy & CRM Knowledge: Comfortable using automated dialing systems, CRM software, and other communication tools.

•
Problem-Solving & Initiative: Strong problem-solving skills, ability to work independently and collaboratively, and a proactive approach to challenges.

•
Resilience & Adaptability: Patience and the ability to perform under pressure while meeting deadlines and sales targets.

•
Education & Leadership: High school diploma or equivalent (Bachelor’s degree preferred but not required); previous experience managing junior sales teammates is a plus.

Benefits

• Above market salary

• HMO on Day 1 for principal and two dependents

• Government-mandated benefits

• Performance-based Incentives

• Quarterly Company Events

• In-depth training for career growth

• Great Company Culture and HR experience

• 1,000 PHP De Minimis

• Equipment and software provided
